# Span timeline

The events are built in app/v3/services/spanTimelineEventsAggregatorImpl.server.ts and
rendered by components/runs/SpanTimelineEventsViewWithFilters2.tsx.
Shared types live in packages/v3/schemas/TaskRunExecutionPayloadSchemaV2
and the presenter in app/v3/presenters/SpanTimelineEventsPresenterImpl.server.
